title: Splitting a list prefix
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a finite Boolean list and let $N,s$ be natural numbers with $N\le s$. Then the prefix of $\sigma$ of length $s$ is the concatenation of its prefix of length $N$ and the prefix of length $s-N$ of the list obtained by removing its first $N$ entries.
